page.overview:
Who is Kazumi?

Kazumi is a young man with dark-brown hair and brown eyes with white pupils.

He wears a dull blue iromuji kimono with a dark-colored obi and light-brown haori. He was eventually seen with bruises in his face.

Kazumi was shown to be a loving and kind person who enjoyed spending time together with his fiancée. Despite his grief over her disappearance, he was shown to be quite trusting, as he believed in Tanjiro's way of trying to find Satoko. Upon learning that she was in fact dead and Tanjiro had encouraged him to move on, Kazumi became upset and asked how he could know his pain, only to quickly realize his savior did indeed endure a terrible loss as well, becoming regretful of his harsh words.

Unlike most civilians, Kazumi seems to know some knowledge about demons and Demon Slayers, having heard about their existence through rumors, though he remains surprised to see them in reality.
